question: WHY DOES THE
WIRE ZIGZAG?
options: So the wire can stretch in the heat
So the contact strip wears evenly
answer_full: So the contact strip wears evenly – engineers call the zigzag stagger
recap: The power wire above a high-speed line zigzags from side to side, even on a straight track.
explain: The pantograph on the roof touches the wire with a carbon strip.
If the wire ran dead straight, it would rub the same narrow spot all the time and wear a groove into that strip.
So the wire is pulled about 20 to 30 centimetres to each side, and the wear is spread across the whole strip. Both the strip and the wire last much longer.
